title: Research dedup: a pack's lack-set fingerprint is checked and claimed through coord.py before /kb-research starts
goal: coord.py dedup "<question>" runs the question's pack, takes its anchor topic and its kb-lacks terms after alias canonicalisation as a fingerprint, and returns either a new claim on that fingerprint or the open claim whose fingerprint overlaps it (with its holder and topic) so the caller waits on its fact_added events instead of researching again; /kb-research runs it as its first step and stops with the holder named when another claim is live.

gates.question: What does /kb-research do when coord.py dedup finds a live claim whose fingerprint overlaps the question?
options: stop, name the holder and the topic, and offer to wait for its fact_added events
go on only for the lack terms the live claim does not cover
gates.recommendation: stop, name the holder and the topic, and offer to wait for its fact_added events
gates.answer: go on only for the lack terms the live claim does not cover

gates.question: How much must two lack-sets overlap on one anchor topic to count as the same research?
options: the same anchor topic and at least half of the smaller lack-set's terms
the same anchor topic and identical lack-sets
measure on the query log's real questions first, then pick
gates.recommendation: measure on the query log's real questions first, then pick
